Beetroot and gin-cured salmon on rye with horseradish crème fraîche, pickled shallot and a splash of green herb oil, splattered like the gallery. Two days ahead, mix 100g salt, 80g sugar, 1 grated raw beetroot and 2 tbsp gin and pack around a 400g salmon fillet. Cover, weigh down and refrigerate 48 hours, then rinse and slice thin. Blitz a bunch of parsley with 80ml oil and strain. Slice 1 shallot thin and soak in 2 tbsp vinegar. Cut 4 slices rye into 16 squares, spread with crème fraîche mixed with horseradish, top with salmon and shallot, and splash herb oil on the plate.

the old-world delis of Gotham's back streets

Piled-high corned beef, tangy sauerkraut and melted Swiss on rye with house Russian dressing, griddled in butter until crisp, with dill pickles. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp horseradish, 1 tbsp chopped pickles and a dash of Worcestershire for Russian dressing. Spread over 8 slices rye. Layer 4 slices with 125g shaved corned beef each, 60g drained sauerkraut and 2 slices Swiss cheese, then close. Butter the outsides and cook in a pan over medium heat with a weight on top for 4 minutes a side until crisp and melted. Halve and serve with pickles.
W: Chocolate cake with purple and green buttercream and a crooked smile
Chocolate cake covered in purple buttercream with green piped swirls and a big crooked smile drawn across the top.
K: Earl Grey infused gin shaken with lemon, honey and egg white

Earl Grey infused gin shaken with lemon, honey and egg white into a silky sour, served in fine coupes with a twist of lemon. Steep 2 Earl Grey tea bags in 200ml gin for 1 hour, then remove. Dissolve 3 tbsp honey in 2 tbsp hot water. Shake the gin, 100ml fresh lemon juice, the honey syrup and 2 egg whites hard without ice for 15 seconds, then add ice and shake again. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and twist lemon peel over each.

steps.text: Trim the cauliflowers, boil whole in salted water for 8 minutes and drain well.
Rub with the melted butter and sea salt flakes and roast at 200C until deep golden, basting now and then.

s.note: Bat shaped fried corn chips with chipotle black bean dip
s.how: Cut 10 corn tortillas with a bat cutter and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Blitz 2 drained tins black beans with 2 garlic cloves, the juice of 2 limes and 1 chipotle in adobo until smooth. Serve the dip with the bats.

m.n: Manor roast beef and Yorkshire pudding
m.note: Rare rib of beef, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and red wine jus
m.how: Salt a 2kg rib of beef overnight. Roast at 120C until 52C inside, rest, then blast at 260C for 10 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Reduce 250ml red wine with 400ml stock for jus.

w.note: Chocolate cake with purple and green buttercream and a crooked smile
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Beat 250g butter with 400g icing sugar, tint most purple and a little green. Cover and pipe a crooked smile.
